Reference short-sleeved clothing is superseded. Personal ship is the established transparent spherical technological field, faint cyan geodesic grid, graphite equatorial band, upper/lower circular platforms, amber rim lights, sparse cyan rectangular lamps and one vertical open aft engine ring with cyan inner arc. Cabin is the established open spherical volume with curved graphite rail/platform and sparse floating holographic controls, not a conventional airplane cockpit. The newly discovered remote planet has a broad dark-emerald jungle continent, copper-coloured inland seas and ivory storm systems, visibly distinct from the opening turquoise/peach world. Only include subjects required by the specific shot. One uninterrupted full-frame cinematic16:9 image, quiet bottom strip for later lyrics; no captions, readable words, watermarks, panels or collage.

SCENE-SPECIFIC EXCLUSIONS: Only a natural loose uneven stellar neighbourhood and sparse blue-purple dust wisps, centered small warm-white star. Absolutely NO people, ship, station, cabin, platforms, geodesic grid, ring, planet, landscape, interface, diagram or text. Ignore all continuity subjects in lock that are not required by this shot.
